TARGET_AUDIENCE: Urban Indian professionals aged 22-30 from Mumbai or Bengaluru taking a quick 48-hour weekend getaway, who have dozens of saved Instagram reels but no structured route.
PAIN_POINT: With only 48 hours on the ground, travellers lose half their weekend stuck in Siolim traffic and bouncing aimlessly between opposite ends of North Goa because saved reels don't account for geography or opening hours.
DESTINATION: North Goa (Vagator cliffline and Ashwem-Morjim coastal strip)
CREATIVE_ANGLE: They know the five spots they want to hit from saved reels, but don't know how to cluster them into a realistic 2-day flow without spending four hours a day on a scooter. The Travafa AI trip planner takes their arrival time, North Goa base, and curated vibe preferences, instantly generating an editable day-by-day itinerary clustered by location so every beach, cafe, and sundowner flows naturally without backtrack driving.
LOOK_CONSTRAINTS: time_of_day: midday, harsh overhead sun, hard shadows; weather: strong wind moving fabric, hair and foliage; palette: cool blues and teals; film_look: authentic phone-shot look, casual framing; human_presence: one traveller, face visible
HOOK_STYLE: the camera opens on an object or detail - a phone screen, a ticket, a bag, a notebook - before the character is revealed
PACING_SHAPE: keep problem, product and result close to equal thirds of the runtime
ENDING_STYLE: the character turns directly to camera in the final part and speaks the CTA themselves; the environment is present but secondary
DIALOGUE_DENSITY: keep the earliest part more visual and silent; let dialogue increase as the story reaches the product and result beats
CharacterStyle: A 26-year-old traveller wearing an oversized faded teal linen shirt open over a white ribbed cotton tank top, washed beige drawstring shorts, tortoiseshell sunglasses perched in windswept hair, and a worn canvas tote bag slung over the bench.
Setting: A rugged red-laterite cliff edge overlooking Vagator beach, with coastal palm tops and wild grass whipping in strong winds against a deep azure-and-teal sea under harsh, direct midday sunlight.
ReferenceTone: Authentic handheld phone-shot aesthetic, documentary-style exposure with sharp midday hard shadows, breezy natural movement, and a crisp oceanic cool blue and teal colour grade.
PhoneShotAction: The traveller holds their phone naturally at a rustic cliffside cafe bench, tapping the Travafa AI trip planner chat to watch a full 2-day North Goa itinerary auto-generate, physically cross-referencing saved beach photos against the day-by-day cards popping onto the screen.
